_comment: GPL/LGPL SOURCE-OFFER MIRROR — the reviewed pin table for corresponding source.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. Correlix redistributes copyleft-licensed binaries as
unmodified upstream container images. GPL-2.0 s3 lets a distributor discharge
the source obligation two ways: (a) ship the corresponding source ALONGSIDE the
binary, or (b) ship a written offer good for three years. Owner decision
2026-09-04 (licence audit D2, docs/security/LICENSE_AUDIT_2026-09-03.md s4 D2)
chose (a) for syslog-ng: MIRROR the exact upstream source tarball into every
shipped release, so the obligation is discharged at hand-over and no future
hosting change, repo rename or upstream deletion can leave us unable to honour
a request. The written offer in the notices now points at the in-bundle copy.
HOW IT IS USED. scripts/make-installer.sh reads this file, fetches each entry,
verifies its sha256 against the pin below, and writes it to the bundle at
source-offer/<file>. A missing pin, a failed download or a checksum mismatch is
a HARD BUILD FAILURE (scripts/CLAUDE.md s16.1) — an unverified tarball is never
shipped, and 'the network was down' never silently produces a bundle whose
source offer is a lie.
ON 'upstream's published sum'. Checked 2026-09-04: the syslog-ng project
publishes NO checksum file, no signature and no release-asset digest for this
asset (the GitHub release API reports `digest: null`), and no distro packaging
we could reach republishes a sha256 for the release tarball (Arch builds from
the git tag; Alpine has no aport). So there is no upstream attestation to
verify against. The `sha256` below is therefore OUR OWN recorded measurement of
the asset downloaded from the canonical release URL, taken and reviewed on
2026-09-04 and checked in here. That is trust-on-first-use, recorded once and
then enforced forever — NOT an upstream guarantee, and it is written down here
rather than implied. `verified_against` states this for each entry so nobody
later mistakes a self-measured pin for a vendor signature.
UPDATING. When the pinned image version changes in deployment/docker, this file
MUST change with it — tests/test_source_offer.py fails the build otherwise.

components.name: syslog-ng
components.verified_against: self-measured 2026-09-04 from the canonical GitHub release asset; upstream publishes no checksum, signature or release-asset digest for this file
components.license: LGPL-2.1-or-later (core: lib/, libtest/, syslog-ng/, syslog-ng-ctl/, persist-tool/, tests/loggen/, docker/) AND GPL-2.0-or-later (modules/, scl/) — verified against COPYING at tag syslog-ng-4.7.1
components.notes: No OpenSSL linking exception exists in this COPYING. The stock balabit/syslog-ng image loads all modules, so the running combination is effectively GPL-2.0-or-later. This tarball IS the corresponding source for that image's syslog-ng.
